description: Defines classes and functions for handling MAC uplink SCH PDU and subPDU structures, including unpacking, decoding, and formatting for logging or display, specific to 3GPP 5G NR specifications.

classes.name: mac_ul_sch_subpdu
classes.description: Represents a sub-Protocol Data Unit (subPDU) in the MAC uplink scheduling, with methods for unpacking and accessing payload and LCID.

classes.name: mac_ul_sch_pdu
classes.description: Represents a MAC uplink scheduling PDU containing multiple subPDUs, with methods for unpacking, accessing subPDUs, and managing the list.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a subPDU from a byte buffer reader or byte buffer.

methods.name: decode_crnti_ce
methods.description: Decodes a C-RNTI MAC Control Element from a byte buffer view.
